'''June 2001 Boxborough tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boxborough, MA on 16 June 2001. Steebo (nickname) won it. It is known from Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2471">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-17-boxborough-6-16-01d2471/ boxborough-6-16-01], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 17 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-17-boxborough-6-16-01d2471/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Boxborough, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' Steebo (nickname)
